purpose: New credible measured-data discoveries awaiting file-level profiling or role assignment. Entries in this queue do not inflate injection-cycle counts and do not become executable MouldMaster benchmarks until their exact files, record units and provenance are profiled.

discoveries.title: AD-STGN for RCA in CMMS — real-world injection molding production-line case
discoveries.recordUnit: process time sample; not assumed to equal one moulding cycle
quality: reported examples include internal bubbles, warpage and incomplete cooling
discoveries.limitation: The published counts are time/process samples rather than proven one-row-per-shot records. MouldMaster must inspect the exact injection-line files, timestamps/grouping, label construction and test-sequence length before any cycle count, causal claim or benchmark adapter is created.

discoveries.title: Data for: Influence of measurement processes on pressure-specific volume-temperature relationships of semi-crystalline polymer: Polypropylene
discoveries.limitation: These are polymer-physics measurements from a piston-die pvT device, not injection-moulding cycles. They can strengthen shrinkage/packing/thermal education but must never be counted as real moulding shots.

discoveries.title: The energy consumption and structural performance of 3D printed FDM parts in PLA & ABS, a comparison with Injection moulding
quality: impact performance of injection-moulded PLA/ABS specimens
discoveries.limitation: The repository provides physical testing of injection-moulded specimens but not a shot-resolved injection process history. It supports material/property learning and manufacturing comparisons, not process-diagnostic cycle counts.

discoveries.title: Interphase formation of low surface energy PE-CVD release coatings in plastic injection moulding
discoveries.limitation: This is surface-characterization data associated with injection-mould release coatings, not shot-level demoulding-force or process-cycle data. It can support coating/interphase education but cannot substitute for physical release-force evidence.

discoveries.title: Data - Model to increase availability using H-SMED, SMED and TPM in the injection molding process in a plastic company
discoveries.recordUnit: database/engineering-method/simulation result; exact source file roles require profiling
discoveries.limitation: The repository mixes underlying database/tooling information with Arena simulation results. MouldMaster must separate measured production records from simulated outputs before any item is counted as measured process evidence.
